journal.title: Reference inspected · Blender ready
journal.notes: Visually reviewed all four supplied views. Using original mesh, procedural markings and a strand groom. No downloaded model, texture, or animal asset is used.

journal.title: First sculpt and multiview review
journal.notes: Coat layout and raised tail recognizable. Correcting protruding eyes, arched ears, gray blacks, segmented legs, and the rectangular cap boundary visible in profile.

journal.title: Continuous anatomy and darker coat
journal.notes: Better legs, tail position and coat contrast. Smaller eyes are partly occluded by cheeks; the next pass carves anatomical eye sockets, tapers ear folds, separates toes and softens the under-chin lighting.

journal.title: Natural eye sockets and soft facial lighting
journal.notes: Eyes now fully visible and integrated. Closed body mesh, finite vertices, matching left/right paw heights. Remaining priorities: furry ear interiors, toe definition, organic tail-root/ankle markings, exact ground contact, and orthographic floor-edge artifacts.
